title: P, Q, R
summary: Learn P, Q, R, then practise with the keys you already know.
intro: Learn P, Q, R, then practise with the keys you already know.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press p to type P. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: PfP PPf PPP fP PPPP PP fff ffP fPff

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press q to type Q. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: QjQQQ QjQQ QQ QQQ jQ QQQQ jjQj

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press r to type R. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: RRR fRRR RRf RR RRRR RRfR RRff

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
screens.content: 2Q PP RP PQP2 RQP QPQ QQQR PP2R QQQ RQQQ PPPP RRRQ PRQ RRRR RPRR P2RP

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
